messages:
olivia: quick heads-up / ran a short int6 sweep for nova-13b on dev slices, focusing on docs-heavy and chat flows. sharing cost vs quality highlights.
ben: thanks. headline numbers?
olivia: token cost down ~40% vs fp16; p50 latency +6ms, p95 +30ms. quality: chat BLEU near-flat (-0.1), docs ROUGE-L down ~1.2 on long retrieval prompts. hallucination rate up from 1.1% -> 3.8% on that slice.
sasha: yikes on hallucination. which prompts trigger it?
olivia: long context (>1800 tokens) + multi-hop summarization + retrieval traces. short chats are fine.
maya_p: product here  we need a mitigation plan. small unit cost wins are not worth user-visible regressions for docs customers.
ben: propose routing: int6 default; detect "docs-like" prompts -> route to fp16. we should compute cost impact for fallbacks.
olivia: quick estimate: if docs-like traffic is 12% and we fallback to fp16 for those, net cost reduction ~34% overall (instead of 40), i.e., +5.5% absolute cost vs full int6 but recovers ROUGE-L ~1.2 and cuts hallucinations back to ~1.3%.
sasha: implementable heuristic: token_count>1700 OR contains("retrieval:") OR prompt_tag=="doc" -> route to fp16. add a toggle for canary.
ben: add canary metrics: hallucination_rate (auto eval), rouge-L sample, per-token cost and p95 latency. rollback if hallucination_rate > baseline + 1.0% within 24h.
eval-bot: ran a simulated 5% pilot: overall hallucination +0.5%, docs slice +1.5%; unit cost reduction on pilot traffic 37%. threshold breach not triggered.
maya_p: product approves 5% pilot with docs fallback classifier. need a short GTN note with ROI numbers and flags.
ben: action list: olivia -> PR router rule (ETA 4h); sasha -> add slice to monitoring + auto-eval (ETA 12h); ben -> draft GTN note + numbers (ETA EOD); maya_p -> sign off rollback criteria (ETA EOD).
olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/rex/pull/4839 (router rule + toggle). will post 24h follow-up after pilot. :thumbsup:
